languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Read the studio in one language, write your story in another, and deliver in as many as you need
languages.interfaceDescription: Menus, buttons, and dialogs across the Dashboard and all three studios.
languages.storyDescription: The language new AI-written treatments, beats, characters, and dialogue are authored in. The header language switcher updates this together with the interface language.
languages.deliveryDescription: Narration, dubs, and rendered video. A single project can ship in many languages at once, so these are chosen per scene rather than per account.
languages.promptsStayEnglish: Image and video prompts stay in English regardless of these settings — the generation models produce noticeably weaker results from translated prompts.
